question: Which bowler has the lowest bowling average per wicket taken?
sql:
-- Let me double-check by running the final query to get the bowler with the lowest bowling average
-- and return just the player name as requested

WITH runs_data AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
wicket_data AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT p.player_name, r.runs_conceded, w.wickets, 
       r.runs_conceded * 1.0 / w.wickets as bowling_avg
FROM runs_data r
JOIN wicket_data w ON r.bowler = w.bowler
JOIN player p ON r.bowler = p.player_id
WHERE w.wickets > 0
ORDER BY bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 1

{"sql": "-- Get runs conceded by each bowler
-- Join ball_by_ball with batsman_scored on match_id, over_id, ball_id
-- The bowler column in ball_by_ball tells us who was bowling
-- runs_scored is the runs off that ball; we sum those to get total runs conceded
SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as balls_faced, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
FROM ball_by_ball bb
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY bb.bowler
ORDER BY runs_conceded
LIMIT 10", "preview_rows": 12}

-- But my wicket join doesn't filter by innings_no, so it might match the wrong innings.
-- Let me add innings_no to the wicket join too.

WITH runs_data AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bb.match_id = bs.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
),
wicket_data AS (
    SELECT bb.bowler, COUNT(*) as wickets
    FROM ball_by_ball bb
    JOIN wicket_taken wt ON bb.match_id = wt.match_id 
        AND bb.over_id = wt.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = wt.innings_no
    WHERE bb.bowler IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY bb.bowler
)
SELECT r.bowler, r.runs_conceded, w.wickets, 
       CASE WHEN w.wickets > 0 THEN r.runs_conceded * 1.0 / w.wickets ELSE NULL END as bowling_avg
FROM runs_data r
JOIN wicket_data w ON r.bowler = w.bowler
ORDER BY bowling_avg ASC
LIMIT 20", "preview_rows": 20}

    SELECT bb.bowler, SUM(bs.runs_scored) as runs_conceded
    FROM ball_by_ball bb

        AND bb.over_id = bs.over_id 
        AND bb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
        AND bb.innings_no = bs.innings_no

        AND bb.ball_id = wt.ball_id

)
SELECT r.bowler, r.runs_conceded, w.wickets,
